title: Bling Gnome
html:
The Bling Gnome
The Bling Gnome Poops!

The Bling Gnome is a brilliant piece of marketing by Dungeon Runners devs! Since so many of us are tired of scooping up gold, and we get tired of all the junk loot lying around, sometimes it just stays there on the floor. BUT -- if you buy the retail box, you get the Bling Gnome as a special Henchman! When this Passive Skill is in your tray, the gnome follows you around and makes rude remarks. But everytime gold drops, this little guy runs over and scoops it up for you!

Not only that, but if you activate the Hot Key, he will also run around and scooop up all items that are Rare (yellow) or below, and then the fun really begins. Yes -- he squats, strains, grunts and actually ... POOPS out a pile of gold! There is also a (very small) chance that he will actually poop a valuable item.

What a guy! Of course, we all want one!

Warning: Since he eats all items yellow or below, he will automatically eat potions, books and waypoint compasses! If you want to save any of these things, look before you hit the hotkey!
